_comment: end.c container_contents() with reportempty: a debug-mode gnome Healer wishes for an empty sack, takes off her gloves, drops everything (Escape skips the drop messages), and #loots the bag with the default full menu style. ':' reaches pickup.c use_container()'s look-inside call, whose 'The bag is empty.' is followed by display_nhwindow(WIN_MESSAGE, FALSE) and its --More--. With nothing carried, the repeated prompt picks 'b' without a menu, so the next two messages share the cleared top line; without the wait they would join the first message instead. The seed, clock, character, and input were chosen for this path.
